title: Body Composition and Carcass Analysis Using EchoMRI-100
author: Patrick Tso
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.2qigdue

steps.title: Calibrate the EchoMRI-100
steps.instruction: Perform system calibration using the calibration tube.

substeps.instruction: Insert the calibration tube into the opening on the right side of the EchoMRI-100 as far in as possible.
Select “Calibrate” at the bottom of the screen.

steps.title: Prepare the Animal
steps.instruction: Weigh the animal and secure it in the restrainer tube.

steps.title: Set Up the Experiment
steps.instruction: Insert the animal into the machine and enter the required metadata.

substeps.instruction: Insert the restrainer tube into the opening on the right side of the EchoMRI-100.
Select “New Experiment” at the bottom of the screen.
Enter body weight in the “Notes” field.

steps.title: Measure Body Composition
steps.instruction: Run the body composition measurement, repeating if necessary for averaging.

substeps.instruction: Select “Start Experiment” to begin measuring (each run takes approximately 1 minute).
Measure each animal 2 or 3 times to determine the average of the repeated runs.

steps.title: Complete the Session
steps.instruction: Remove the animal from the machine once the process is finished.

substeps.instruction: Wait for the small box in the upper, left-hand corner to read “Experiment Complete.”
Remove the restrainer from the machine.
Return the animal to its home cage.

steps.title: Process Additional Animals
steps.instruction: Repeat the setup, measurement, and completion steps for all remaining animals.
